General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Work on finalisation of master thesis strated to progressing better and 4 more candidates defended their theses in the past reporting period. It seems that recent decision to enable financial support for students from both cohorts of EMI master study motivated students and increased competition which already gave visible results.
The Faculty is making continous actions to help and motivate students to achive better progress. Tutors and other professors make efforts to encourage and push as much students from both cohort in finalisation of their master theses.
